news_analysis.headline_hook: SIP la record inflow irundhum, record-a stop aagura accounts: The real math behind your portfolio.
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Mutual fund SIP inflows hit a record high in September, even though 10 lakh more SIPs were stopped than started during the month.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Record headline SIP figures imply retail investors are uniformly expanding their commitments across the board.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Gross SIP collection totals can rise due to larger ticket sizes or existing commitments, even while a net negative count of 10 lakh accounts indicates substantial discontinuations, tenure completions, or redemptions that top-line inflows conceal.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Track your personal investment tenure and cash-flow capacity instead of treating aggregate monthly inflow milestones as market sentiment signals.
news_analysis.editorial_directive: Use conversational Tanglish. Avoid formal jargon. Focus on the contrast between the 'record high' headline and the 'hidden churn' reality. Ensure the reader feels the need to check their own SIP status before judging the market.

deck.caption:
SIP High Inflows headline paathu ஏமாந்துறாதீங்க! September-la Record Inflows வந்தாலும், 10 Lakh more accounts stop ஆகியிருக்கு. Headlines காட்டுற 🔍 illusion-a நம்பாம, unga personal cash flow & long-term goals-a mattum check pannunga.

Neenga ippo market trends-kaaga unga SIP-a stop or pause panna ninaikireengala? Comments-la sollunga!
